MINUTES OF MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN SIGMA (PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON 2 3 RD DAY OF FEBRUARY 2021 
 
 Agenda 
 
 AVAILING LOAN FROM ZAMEEN VENTURE ONE (PRIVATE) LIMITED 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to avail a loan in the principal amount of 25 , 1 00,000 (Rupees twenty-five million one hundred thousan d ) from Zameen Venture One (Private) Limited (“ Lender ”). 
 
 The Board unanimously nominated Zeeshan Ali Khan t o discuss, negotiate, and accept this proposal. 
 
 Resolutions 
 
 After discussing the aforesaid matter in detail, the following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board: 
 
 Resolved by the Board that the Company avail a loan in the principal amount of Rs. 25 , 1 00,000 (Rupees twenty-five million one hundred thousan d ) from the Lender . 
 
 Resolved further by the Board that Zeeshan Ali Khan is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute all such acts, deeds and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transaction. 
 
 
 
 ____________________ 
 Company Secretary
